_doc: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria (Unreal Engine 4.27, IoStore, Zlib, versioned properties: no mappings file, no Oodle DLL needed). install = the game folder (the one holding Moria/). Orcs and goblins share one skeleton (Orc_Parent_Skeleton) and are assembled from body/head/armour parts in Blueprints; the leaders ship as complete meshes, so the profile names those units and the weapon their equipment Blueprint (EQ_*) holds.
name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria

units.name: OrcLeader_Gundabad
units._source: BP_OrcLeader_Gundabad (mesh Orc_Gundabad_Leader01); Gundabad orcs carry EQ_Orc_Gundabad_Sword_2h (IL_Orc_Gundabad_Sword_2h) = StaticMesh E_Weapon_Orc_CurvedSword2h at identity on the right-hand socket
units._clips: UA_* clips are unarmed (hands open); with the 2h sword the game layers Swd2H_* poses, so only those hold the sword

rig_map.head: Head_JNT
rig_map._doc: Moria orc/goblin rig (Orc_Parent_Skeleton): *_JNT body joints, lower-case face joints

backend._doc: Orc attack frames make good minis, so melee clips are in; hit reactions and deaths stay out.
